data.statement: Simplify Speech Blocks persistence from 3 files (speech_blocks.json list + report + state) to a single authoritative speech_blocks.json document; drop redundant report/state duplication and the source_chunks text copy; keep functional behavior identical (generate, resume, resplit, approvals, export, manifest sync). Per plan 0_Planning/Speech_Blocks_Metadata_Simplification.md.

acceptance: Only one speech_blocks.json written; report/state files no longer created; artifact has no source_chunks text copy; generate/resume/resplit/approvals/insert-delete/reset behave identically; export+manifest produce identical summaries; character-edit lock while running works; legacy-format artifact treated as absent (None); reset clears legacy files; full pytest green + ruff clean + docs updated.
assumptions: Single-document file name is SPEECH_BLOCKS_DOCUMENT_FILE_NAME=speech_blocks.json (decided in plan section 4.1).
Migration is reset-and-regenerate: no legacy-format reader, legacy/list artifact treated as absent -> None; reset clears legacy report/state files (plan section 5).
Compatibility projections keep public signatures load_speech_blocks_report()/load_operation_state() stable so external callers are unchanged.
open_questions: Confirm existing projects with old-format Speech Blocks artifacts must be re-run (breaking persistence change, documented in CHANGELOG)?
data.reason: Breaking persistence change (existing projects must re-run Speech Blocks); risk medium meets policy threshold, so human approval is required before requirement/spec work.
recommended_responses: Yes: reset-and-regenerate as the plan decided; no migration code, CHANGELOG notes the breaking change.
scope: IN: config.py file-name constants, speech_blocks_report_state_service.py, speech_blocks_service.py document read/write+projections+resume+reset, speech_blocks_state_service.py, consumers (project_export_service, project_workspace_service, operation_runtime_service, audio_blocks_service, characters_ui_controller, text_chunking_state_service, speech_blocks_ui_controller), tests, component + software docs, CHANGELOG. OUT: individual block format, prompts, AI logic, UI; other operations (audio_blocks/audio_assembly).
data.understanding: Reduce Speech Blocks persistence from three artifacts (speech_blocks.json as a bare list, speech_blocks_report.json, speech_blocks_state.json) to a single authoritative speech_blocks.json document object, mirroring the Character Discovery single-document refactor (commit 1d8e718). Non-derivable fields (source kind/language/fingerprint, ai_profile_id, instructions, scene_ambience, response_contract, token_usage, budget_metadata, resume checkpoint, log path, blocks) are persisted once; report/state counts and warnings are recomputed on read via compatibility projections; the source_chunks text copy is removed and re-resolved from upstream. Functional behavior (generate, resume by chunk+segment, resplit, approvals, insert/delete, reset, export, manifest sync, character-edit locking) stays identical.

data.summary: 9 new single-document contract tests fail red (missing write/load_speech_blocks_document, SpeechBlocksDocumentError, projections, SPEECH_BLOCKS_DOCUMENT_FILE_NAME): 9 failed.

Full suite green for the change: 965 passed, 1 skipped; the only 2 failures (test_traceability, test_blocks_performance_baseline) are pre-existing branch debt, verified identical with changes stashed.

data.rationale: One authoritative document removes the redundant report and state artifacts that previously duplicated Speech Blocks metadata.
data.requirement: Speech Blocks shall persist all operation metadata and blocks in a single authoritative speech_blocks.json document with a fixed top-level field set, and shall not create speech_blocks_report.json or speech_blocks_state.json.
data.verification: Single-document round-trip and no report/state files; test passes in full green suite.

data.rationale: Storing a full source-text copy duplicated upstream data; re-resolving from upstream keeps a single source of truth, matching Character Discovery.
data.requirement: The Speech Blocks document shall not persist a copy of upstream source-chunk text; it shall retain only source.fingerprint and re-resolve source chunks from upstream artifacts (chunks_text.json or translated_text.json) at read time.
data.verification: Artifact excludes source_chunks; source keeps only fingerprint.

data.rationale: External callers depend on the existing report/state shapes; projecting them from the single document keeps those consumers unchanged.
data.requirement: load_speech_blocks_report() and load_operation_state() shall return projections derived from the single Speech Blocks document that match the previous separate report and operation-state artifacts in shape and values (counts, warnings, stage/status, resume checkpoint, progress).

data.rationale: Resume must survive the persistence change without altering chunk/segment continuation behavior.
data.requirement: Speech Blocks resume shall read next_chunk_index, active_chunk_id, next_segment_index, completed_segment_count, run_token and source.fingerprint from document.checkpoint so chunk-level and segment-level resume behave identically to the previous state file.

data.rationale: Reset-and-regenerate migration avoids tolerant legacy readers; non-conforming artifacts must present as not-started.
data.requirement: A legacy list-format speech_blocks.json or a missing document shall be treated as not-started: load_speech_blocks_document() shall return None and no legacy report or state file shall be read or converted.

data.rationale: Operators regenerating after the format change must not be left with stale legacy artifacts.
data.requirement: reset_speech_blocks shall remove the single speech_blocks.json document and any residual legacy speech_blocks_report.json and speech_blocks_state.json files so the operator can regenerate cleanly.
data.verification: Reset removes document and legacy files.
